questions.q_en: 25 men completely build a wall working for 40 days. After working for 24 days 35 more men joined the workers. Now remaining portion of the wall will be built in how many days?
questions.solution_en:
According to the question 25 men can complete the work in 40 days hence amount of work done by 1 man in one day = 1/((25 X 40) )=1/1000

Total amount of work done in 24 days = (25 X 24)/1000=3/5

Now remaining work = 1- 3/5=2/5

Now total number of people working to build a wall = (25 + 35) = 60

Let's suppose they will take 'N' days to complete the remaining work. Therefore: 1/1000 X 60 X N=2/5

=> N=(2 X 1000)/(5 X 60)

=> N=6 2/3 Days

So, remaining work will be completed in 6(2/3) Days.

questions.q_en: A policeman noticed a thief from 400 m. The thief started running and the policeman was chasing him. The thief and the policeman ran at the speeds of 14 km/hr and 15 km/hr, respectively. What was the distance between them after 4 minutes?
questions.solution_en:
Relative speed of policeman with respect to thief = 15 - 14 = 1 km/hr

Distance between policeman and thief after 4 minutes = 1 x (4/60) km = 1/15 km

Initial distance = 400 m = 2/5 km

Required distance = (2/5) - (1/15) = 5/15 = 1/3 km

[2 (Length + Breadth)]/ [4 * Side] = 13/12

(56 + Side)/ 2 * Side = 13/12

questions.q_en: Pipe A can fill a tank in 50 minutes, while pipe B alone can fill it in 75 minutes and pipe C can empty the full tank in 1 hour. If all the pipes are opened together and the pipe B is closed 12 minutes before the tank is filled, then how much time will be needed to make the tank full?
questions.solution_en:
Suppose the tank is filled in T minutes.

According to the question, pipes A and C are open for T minutes and pipe B for (T-12) minutes.

T/50 + (T-12)/75 - T/60 = 1

(6T+4T-48-5T)/300 = 1

(5T-48)/300 = 1

5T = 348

T = 69.6 minutes

Hence, the tank is filled in 69.6 minutes

questions.q_en: The ratio between the radius of a circle and the side of an equilateral triangle is 9: 4 and the circumference of the circle is 198/7 cm. Find the perimeter of triangle.
questions.solution_en:
Let the radius of the circle be 9X and side of the triangle be 4X.

Circumference of the circle = 198/7

2 x π x (9X) = 198/7

2 x (22/7) x (9X) = 198/7

X = 1/2

Therefore, the side of the triangle be 4 x (1/2) = 2 cm

Perimeter of triangle = 2 + 2 + 2 = 6 cm

A container contains 96 ml of mixture of chemical A and chemical B in the ratio of 5: 7 respectively. If 36 ml of mixture is taken out from that container and then 40 ml of chemical B added to it, what will be the percentage of chemical A in the final mixture?
questions.solution_en:
A container contains 96 ml of mixture of chemical A and chemical B in the ratio of 5: 7 respectively.

Total quantity of chemical A = 96 * (5/12)= 40 ml

Total quantity of chemical B = 96 * (7/12) = 56 ml

Chemical A in 36 ml of mixture= 36 * (5/12)=15 ml

New mixture= 96- 36 + 40=100 ml

Chemical A in new mix= 40 - 15 =25 ml

Percentage of chemical A in final mixture= (25/100)*100=25%

questions.q_en: The average height of 15 students is 160 cm. If one student of height 180 cm leaves and is replaced by a new student, then the new average becomes 158 cm. What is the new student's height?

New Sum: 15 X 158 = 2370

New Student's Height = New Sum - (Initial Sum - Removed Student)

Height = 2370 - (2400 - 180) = 2370 - 2220 = 150 cm

questions.q_en: Find the value of 'k' for which the system of equations 4x+6y=7 and 6x+(k+4)y-21=0 has a unique solution.
questions.solution_en:
We know by a pair of linear equation:-

a1x + b1y = c1

a2x + b2y = c2

The condition for a unique solution is:

a1/a2≠b1/b2

we have the equation as:-

4x + 6y - 7 = 0

6x + (k+4)y - 21= 0

Here a1=4, b1=6 and a2=6 and b2=(k+4)

So :

4/6 ≠ 6/(k+4)

4k+16≠ 36

4k≠20

k≠5

option (b) is the correct answer.

questions.q_en: P can do a piece of work in 30 days and Q in 40 days. They work together for 4 days and then Q leaves. The number of days taken by P to finish the remaining work is:
questions.solution_en:
Total work = LCM of 30 and 40 = 120 units

Efficiency of P = 120/30 = 4

Efficiency of Q = 120/40 = 3

Work done in 4 days = 4(4 + 3) = 28

Remaining work = 120 - 28 = 92 units

Time taken by P to finish the remaining work = 92/4 = 23 days
